project.title: Period comparison: waiting time vs active work (workflow not yet named)

decisions.question: Which workflow, which two reporting periods (start and end dates) and what business question motivate the comparison? No export, period or workflow scope was supplied on 2026-09-21.
Who is the process owner accountable for producing the two exports and for the follow-up measure (section 5 of process-improvement-report.md)?

Which Provia event marks the start of active work on an action (assignment/claim, first comment, first field edit or an explicit start step)? Without it waiting and active work cannot be separated and only cycle time and unclassified duration can be reported.
decisions.owner: Process owner with the Provia administrator

decisions.question: Did both periods run on the same workflow version? If not, how do action ids map between versions so that per-action waiting and active figures are comparable?
Confirm country, timezone and response language. Angola, Africa/Luanda and English were assumed provisionally; the workday figures assume a Monday–Friday week and do not skip public holidays.
